config.feature: Arithmetic mean of original channel pixels within the original nonzero cell mask; overlapping tiles use union of nonzero masks and unique global pixels; float64 accumulation
config.positive_rule: upstream rescale score > 0.5; exactly 0.5 assigned negative
config.fit_population: All segmented cells with finite nonnegative mean, irrespective of annotation
config.unit: PhenoBIC: each original WSI (internal tiles reconstructed without duplicated overlap pixels) or each TMA core
config.evaluation: Original splits preserved; no label tuning. Per-unit unsupervised calibration on target-image intensities is transductive, not frozen-threshold inference.
config.ranking_metrics: ROC-AUC and average precision use continuous SCIMAP rescaled scores; scores are not calibrated probabilities.
config.pan_ambiguous: Original 2/3 retained in prediction tables and counted separately; undefined as binary ground truth, so do not enter 0/1 metrics.
config.split_policy: PhenoBIC only, original train/internal/external partitions retained. Entire Pan-M Gold sealed for later blind evaluation; no access during current analysis.
config.statistics: Cell-weighted pooled confusion statistics and ROC/AP; equal-weight unit macro mean/std; descriptive only, no cell-independence p-values or CIs
